a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone takes, so it would almost certainly kill us both. I'm not going to pretend otherwise. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us survives. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather not race, operate instead and I'll give back anything beyond 4. I won't mislead you about what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you so directly. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild toward 4 for you, and I won't take any more.
